title: RegulatoryLegacyGateScannerNormalizationTable

_meta.purpose: Normalize every legacy command, scanner, hosted dashboard, and gate reference used by the regulatory/security program into productized adapters, API/event/evidence records, cloud-ci Rust gate packets, and dashboard/trust-portal query surfaces without making CLI or scanner output the product path.
_meta.claim_ceiling: Planning/spec table only. This artifact does not implement scanners, adapters, APIs, cloud-ci gates, dashboards, trust-portal exports, branch protection, runtime admission, certification, readiness, or production security posture.
authority_inputs: docs/AGENTS.md lines 55-75 and 184-193: ADR-0515 makes legacy oya gate/verify local feedback only while oya-ci-required/cloud-ci Rust gate packets own merge authority.
docs/decisions/ADR-0039-supply-chain-security-trivy-cosign-sbom-signed-commits.md: proposed supply-chain security scanner/signing/SBOM/admission posture retained as planning context only.
specs/security-validation-pipeline-matrix.json: runner-neutral security-validation matrix and evidence API contract.
specs/vulnerability-intelligence-sbom-vex-pipeline.json: scanner output is bridge input data until normalized into vulnerability/admission records.
non_goals: No new CLI, shell, oya-dev-cli, oya gate, or oya verify surface.
No new scanner invocation, hosted scanner integration, runtime service, API server, dashboard implementation, trust-portal implementation, or branch-protection change.
No claim that GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Prow, a scanner exit code, SARIF, or any hosted dashboard is canonical product/merge/security authority.
No mutation to generated JSON, runtime code, or cloud-ci gate crates in this planning slice.

contract.normalization_rule: Legacy command, scanner, hosted-dashboard, CI-runner, or shell output is untrusted bridge data until a product adapter parses it against trusted policy, binds it to subject identity and source revision, emits a typed evidence record, and contributes to a cloud-ci Rust gate packet or product state machine. Dashboards and trust portals read/query that normalized state; they do not own the decision.
contract.go_no_go_rule: Any new program reference that lacks a row in this table, teaches a CLI/scanner as the product path, or treats local/hosted output as merge/readiness/security authority is NO-GO until normalized here or explicitly marked out of scope by an accepted authority.
contract.refresh_policy: Refresh on every new scanner/gate/legacy command reference, on ADR-0515/cloud-ci doctrine changes, and at least quarterly while legacy bridge references remain in active docs or specs.

normalization_rows.current_role: Historical/local feedback and provenance only; optional developer diagnostics during migration.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: cloud-ci required-context adapter that converts trusted gate semantics into Rust gate packets; legacy command output may be attached as non-authoritative local evidence only.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Typed gate result with gate_id, source_revision, trusted_base_policy_ref, candidate_tree_hash, normalized subject refs, verdict, failure reasons, producer identity, timestamp, and audit-chain ref.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: oya-ci-required constituent packet emitted by cloud-ci Rust gate apps; protected merge readiness is the aggregate oya-ci-required context, not local command exit status.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: CI/gate result panel showing cloud-ci packet status plus local bridge evidence badges clearly labeled non-authoritative.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: No customer trust-portal surface unless the gate contributes to an approved customer-facing compliance evidence packet; bridge CLI logs are never exported as authoritative evidence.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: If the legacy command's semantics diverge from the Rust gate packet or are not mapped, block the claim and create a retirement/normalization follow-up rather than extending the CLI.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not add docs, acceptance criteria, branch protection, or product flows that make oya gate/verify/oya-dev-cli a product, merge, readiness, or compliance authority.

legacy_reference_patterns: hosted CI status checks other than oya-ci-required
normalization_rows.current_role: Runner or historical/provenance transport. ADR-0515 permits GitHub Actions as current live runner, but the product contract remains cloud-ci Rust gate packets aggregated into oya-ci-required.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: Runner adapter that executes or transports trusted cloud-ci Rust gate packets and uploads signed packet receipts.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Signed runner invocation and gate-packet receipt with runner identity, workflow ref, packet digest, source revision, and protected context URL.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: cloud-ci full-matrix gate packet; oya-ci-required is the only protected aggregate named by this program.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Pipeline dashboard reads cloud-ci packet state and runner invocation metadata; runner UI links are drill-down evidence, not state authority.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Trust portal may expose release/pipeline assurance summaries derived from signed packets, never raw CI workflow success as standalone proof.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Any runner-only or Jenkins/Prow/GitHub-specific policy not represented in a cloud-ci packet blocks merge-authority claims until converted or retired.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not make GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Prow, or branch-protection snippets the north-star product/gate surface.

normalization_rows.current_role: License-vetted scanner/format bridge input for vulnerability, secret, container, and IaC findings.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: security scanner adapter that pins scanner version/ruleset, parses JSON/SARIF, deduplicates findings, binds findings to artifact digest/source revision, and emits normalized security-validation/vulnerability records.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Finding evidence with scanner_id/version, ruleset digest, subject_kind, subject_ref, artifact_digest, source_revision, finding_id, severity, exploitability, remediation_ref, freshness, and audit-chain ref.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: security-validation and vulnerability-intelligence constituent packets inside oya-ci-required; packet verdict comes from normalized records plus policy thresholds, not scanner exit code alone.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Security validation dashboard groups normalized findings by lane, subject, severity, exception/VEX state, owner, SLA, and remediation case.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Customer/auditor trust portal exposes approved vulnerability posture summaries, SBOM/VEX packet refs, and remediation SLAs derived from normalized records; raw SARIF is not the canonical decision.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Unknown scanner version, missing ruleset digest, stale database, unparseable SARIF/JSON, or missing artifact binding blocks the lane result.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not treat Trivy stdout/SARIF, scanner exit code, or hosted SARIF UI as product/security authority by itself.

normalization_rows.current_role: Bridge input for Rust dependency vulnerability and license-policy evidence.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: dependency intelligence adapter that normalizes crate/package identity, advisory aliases, license policy, affected ranges, yanked/informational status, and fix availability.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Dependency evidence bound to package URL, lockfile/source revision, advisory id/aliases, affected range, license expression, policy version, fix version, owner, and audit ref.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: supply-chain/dependency-policy packet in oya-ci-required fed by normalized component and policy records.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Dependency-risk dashboard shows normalized advisory/license records, affected components, fixes, exceptions, and SLA status.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Trust portal may expose SBOM/VEX/license summaries for released artifacts after signed evidence approval; raw cargo command output is never exported as authoritative proof.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Missing lockfile binding, missing advisory freshness, ambiguous alias/range mapping, or absent license policy version blocks pass claims.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not make cargo-audit/cargo-deny command success the canonical merge or release authority without cloud-ci packet/evidence normalization.

normalization_rows.current_role: External source feed input for vulnerability intelligence; never sufficient alone for product decisions.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: advisory ingestion adapter with signed fetch receipts, freshness policy, id/alias normalization, source precedence, and air-gap mirror support.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Feed receipt and normalized advisory evidence with source URL, fetched_at, signature/hash, freshness deadline, vulnerability ids/aliases, modified/published times, CVSS/EPSS/KEV/SSVC fields, and mirror provenance.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: vulnerability-intelligence freshness and risk-prioritization packet; stale or unsigned feed records fail closed per policy.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Vulnerability intelligence dashboard shows feed freshness, alias graph, risk scoring, KEV/EPSS overlays, mirror status, and blockers.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Trust portal exposes curated customer-impact vulnerability attestations/VEX packets derived from normalized feed and SBOM matches.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Missing signature/hash, stale feed, unresolved alias graph, missing KEV/EPSS for high/critical rows, or stale air-gap mirror blocks affected claims.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not cite a feed dashboard/API response as a complete readiness or safety claim without normalized matching against signed SBOM/artifacts and policy.

normalization_rows.current_role: Artifact evidence inputs for supply-chain assurance and vulnerability matching.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: attestation adapter that verifies signatures/inclusion/provenance, binds SBOM documents to artifact digests and source revisions, and indexes component PURLs.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Signed SBOM/provenance evidence with artifact digest, builder identity, source revision, SBOM format/version, component index digest, Rekor/Fulcio refs, SLSA predicate, and audit-chain ref.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: supply-chain provenance packet; release/admission claims require verified evidence records, not raw command logs.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Release/supply-chain dashboard shows artifact evidence packet status, SBOM coverage, signature state, provenance level, and missing-evidence blockers.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Tenant trust portal exports approved SBOM/provenance/VEX packets and freshness badges per artifact or tenant release.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Unsigned SBOM, missing dual-format coverage where required, absent Rekor/provenance binding, or ambiguous artifact digest blocks release/trust claims.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not treat cosign/Rekor/SBOM command output pasted in logs as the product evidence store without typed receipts and artifact binding.

normalization_rows.current_role: Optional enrichment, transport, or external observation source; not canonical state.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: hosted-dashboard import adapter that records source, scope, retrieval time, finding identity mapping, confidence, tenant/data boundary, and provenance before joining product state.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: External observation evidence with provider id, retrieval receipt, scope, finding mapping, subject binding, confidence, policy status, owner, and audit ref.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: Only normalized imported observations can influence cloud-ci packets; raw hosted dashboard green/red state cannot satisfy required contexts.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Oyatie security dashboards may link to hosted dashboards as drill-down while preserving Oyatie normalized state as the source of truth.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Trust portal exposes only curated Oyatie evidence packets; hosted dashboard screenshots or URLs are supplementary and must be labeled as such.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Unknown scope, stale snapshot, provider-only severity without policy mapping, or missing subject binding blocks authority claims.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not outsource canonical security posture, remediation state, readiness, or tenant evidence to a hosted dashboard.

normalization_rows.current_role: Bridge/reference admission mechanism or future runtime enforcement input; this planning slice does not implement runtime admission.
normalization_rows.canonical_adapter: admission-decision adapter that consumes signed artifact evidence, vulnerability/VEX state, policy bundle version, tenant/cell classification, and emits admission verdict records.
normalization_rows.evidence_record: Admission evidence with policy bundle digest, artifact digest, tenant/cell context, decision inputs, verdict, denial reason, expiration/freshness, and audit-chain ref.
normalization_rows.cloud_ci_rust_gate_packet: Pre-release/admission-readiness packet may validate decision records and policy bundles once an implementation card is approved; no runtime admission is claimed here.
normalization_rows.dashboard_surface: Deployment/admission dashboard reads verdict records and blocker reasons by tenant/cell/artifact.
normalization_rows.trust_portal_surface: Trust portal may show signed admission/promotion assurance summaries for released artifacts where approved by product policy.
normalization_rows.unknown_or_stale_semantics_blocker: Missing signed evidence, stale policy bundle, unresolved VEX, missing tenant/cell classification, or unverified artifact digest blocks admission claims.
normalization_rows.forbidden_product_path: Do not treat a Kyverno/OPA example or cluster log as proof of runtime enforcement without the typed verdict/evidence contract and approved implementation lane.

blocker_rows.summary: A legacy command/scanner/gate/hosted-dashboard reference used by the regulatory/security program lacks a normalization row.
blocker_rows.resolution_path: Add or update a row with bridge input, canonical adapter, typed evidence record, cloud-ci packet, dashboard/trust-portal surface, blocker semantics, and forbidden product path before using the reference in acceptance criteria or product docs.
blocker_rows.claim_ceiling: No merge/security/readiness/product authority claim may depend on the unmapped reference.

blocker_rows.summary: A doc, spec, card, or PR teaches scanner or oya gate/verify output as canonical product, merge, compliance, or readiness authority.
blocker_rows.resolution_path: Rewrite the reference to the canonical adapter/evidence/cloud-ci packet path or create a retirement/fix-forward card; do not extend the CLI.
blocker_rows.claim_ceiling: Affected docs/specs/cards are NO-GO until the authority regression is removed.

verification_notes: REGNORM-001 is satisfied by this table only if every active program reference to a legacy command/scanner/gate maps to a row above or is explicitly out of scope by accepted authority.
Focused validation for this artifact is JSON parsing plus row-field completeness and no-CLI-authority text inspection.
This table intentionally preserves ADR-0039 scanner/signing/admission examples as planning context while routing authority through normalized evidence records and cloud-ci Rust gate packets.
